import os, math, time, torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch.utils.cpp_extension import load
import b200probe
D='/tmp/r10s'
os.environ['TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST']='10.0a'
ext = load(name='r10st', sources=[D+'/kst.cu', D+'/bind.cpp'], extra_cuda_cflags=['-O3','--use_fast_math','-std=c++17','-DTC_STAMPS=1','-DTC2_STAMPS=1','-gencode=arch=compute_100a,code=sm_100a'], extra_ldflags=['-lcuda'], verbose=False)
def gen(B,C,H,W,seed=200):
    g=torch.Generator(device='cuda'); g.manual_seed(seed)
    r=lambda *s: torch.randn(*s, device='cuda', generator=g)
    return [r(B,C,H,W), r(C,1,7,7)/math.sqrt(7), r(C), torch.ones(C,device='cuda'), torch.zeros(C,device='cuda'),
            r(4*C,C)/math.sqrt(C), r(4*C), r(1,1,1,4*C)/math.sqrt(4*C), r(1,1,1,4*C), r(C,4*C)/math.sqrt(4*C), r(C)]
def ref64(ins):
    x,dww,dwb,lnw,lnb,w1,b1,gw,gb,w2,b2=[t.double() for t in ins]; C=x.shape[1]
    d=F.conv2d(x,dww,dwb,padding=3,groups=C).permute(0,2,3,1)
    a=F.layer_norm(d,(C,),lnw,lnb,1e-6); h=F.gelu(a@w1.t()+b1)
    G=torch.norm(h,p=2,dim=(1,2),keepdim=True); N=G/(G.mean(dim=-1,keepdim=True)+1e-6)
    h=gw*(h*N)+gb+h; y=h@w2.t()+b2
    return x+y.permute(0,3,1,2)
st=torch.zeros(148*24,dtype=torch.int64,device='cuda')
def stamps(ins,out,mode):
    for _ in range(3):
        st.zero_(); b200probe.flush_l2(); ext.runm(*ins,out,mode,st); torch.cuda.synchronize()
    s=st.view(148,24).cpu().double()
    t0=s[:,0][s[:,0]>0].min()
    res={}
    for i in range(1,16):
        col=s[:,i]; m=col>1e12
        if m.sum()==0: continue
        v=(col[m]-t0)/1000.0
        res[i]=(round(v.median().item(),2), round(v.max().item(),2), int(m.sum()))
    return res, s
for (B,C,H,W) in [(16,384,14,14),(8,768,7,7),(32,768,7,7)]:
    ins=gen(B,C,H,W); out=torch.empty(B,C,H,W,device='cuda')
    ref=ref64(ins)
    for mode in (0,1):
        r,s=stamps(ins,out,mode)
        err=(out.double()-ref).abs().max().item()
        print(B,C,H,W,'mode',mode,'maxerr %.3e'%err)
        print('   ', r)
        if mode==0:
            it=s[:,16]; m=(s[:,15]>1e12)&(s[:,14]>1e12)&(it>1)
            per=((s[:,15]-s[:,14])[m]/(it[m]-1)).median().item()/1000
            print('    parent G2 stage us (median):', round(per,3))
        else:
            m=(s[:,8]>1e12)&(s[:,7]>1e12)
            print('    tc2 G2 first->last ready us (median):', round(((s[:,8]-s[:,7])[m]).median().item()/1000,3))
    fn0=lambda *a: ext.runm(*a, 0, torch.empty(0,dtype=torch.int64,device='cuda'))
    fn1=lambda *a: ext.runm(*a, 1, torch.empty(0,dtype=torch.int64,device='cuda'))
    t=[]
    for rep in range(2):
        t.append((round(b200probe.harness_time(fn0, ins, [out]),1), round(b200probe.harness_time(fn1, ins, [out]),1)))
    print('    harness (mode0, mode1):', t)

import os, math, time, torch, subprocess
import torch.nn.functional as F
import b200probe
D='/tmp/r10p'
from torch.utils.cpp_extension import load
os.environ['TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST']='10.0a'
ext = load(name='r10p', sources=[D+'/k.cu', D+'/bind.cpp'], extra_cuda_cflags=['-O3','--use_fast_math','-std=c++17','-gencode=arch=compute_100a,code=sm_100a'], extra_ldflags=['-lcuda'], build_directory=D, verbose=False)
r=subprocess.run(f"cuobjdump -sass -fun '_Z9tc_kernelILi768ELi49EEv3TCP' {D}/r10p.so | grep -cE 'STL|LDL'", shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
print('tc_kernel<768> STL/LDL count:', r.strip())
def gen(B,C,H,W):
    r=lambda *s: torch.randn(*s, device='cuda')
    return [r(B,C,H,W), r(C,1,7,7)/math.sqrt(7), r(C), torch.ones(C,device='cuda'), torch.zeros(C,device='cuda'),
            r(4*C,C)/math.sqrt(C), r(4*C), r(1,1,1,4*C)/math.sqrt(4*C), r(1,1,1,4*C), r(C,4*C)/math.sqrt(4*C), r(C)]
def ref64(ins):
    x,dww,dwb,lnw,lnb,w1,b1,gw,gb,w2,b2=[t.double() for t in ins]; C=x.shape[1]
    d=F.conv2d(x,dww,dwb,padding=3,groups=C).permute(0,2,3,1)
    a=F.layer_norm(d,(C,),lnw,lnb,1e-6); h=F.gelu(a@w1.t()+b1)
    G=torch.norm(h,p=2,dim=(1,2),keepdim=True); N=G/(G.mean(dim=-1,keepdim=True)+1e-6)
    h=gw*(h*N)+gb+h; y=h@w2.t()+b2
    return x+y.permute(0,3,1,2)
# precision log (shipped config, mode -1 = tc2 on its rows)
for (B,C,H,W,atol) in [(16,384,14,14,3.3e-3),(8,384,14,14,2.8e-3)]:
    torch.manual_seed(200); mx=0; nb=0
    for rnd in range(10):
        ins=gen(B,C,H,W); out=torch.empty(B,C,H,W,device='cuda'); ext.runm(*ins,out,1)
        ref=ref64(ins); err=(out.double()-ref).abs()
        mx=max(mx,err.max().item()); nb+=int((err>atol+1e-5*ref.abs()).sum().item())
    print(f'PREC tc2 {B},{C}: max|err| {mx:.3e} vs atol {atol} ({100*mx/atol:.0f}%), beyond {nb}')
# stress: 1500 calls, fixed inputs, max err per call
for (B,C,H,W,mode) in [(8,768,7,7,0),(16,384,14,14,1),(16,384,14,14,0)]:
    torch.manual_seed(7); ins=gen(B,C,H,W); ref=ref64(ins).float(); out=torch.empty(B,C,H,W,device='cuda')
    worst=torch.zeros((),device='cuda'); first=None
    t=time.time()
    for i in range(1500):
        ext.runm(*ins,out,mode); e=(out-ref).abs().max(); worst=torch.maximum(worst,e)
        if i==0: first=e.item()
    torch.cuda.synchronize()
    print(f'STRESS {B},{C} mode {mode}: first {first:.3e} worst over 1500 {worst.item():.3e} ({time.time()-t:.1f}s)')
# interleaved timing x3: mode0 (parent tc) vs tc2 shipped config
for (B,C,H,W) in [(16,384,14,14),(8,384,14,14)]:
    torch.manual_seed(1); ins=gen(B,C,H,W); out=torch.empty(B,C,H,W,device='cuda')
    res=[]
    for rep in range(3):
        a=b200probe.harness_time(lambda *z: ext.runm(*z,0), ins, [out]); b=b200probe.harness_time(lambda *z: ext.runm(*z,1), ins, [out])
        res.append((round(a,1),round(b,1)))
    print('TIME', B,C, '(parent, tc2):', res)

D='/tmp/r10p'
s=subprocess.run(f"cuobjdump -sass -fun '_Z9tc_kernelILi768ELi49EEv3TCP' {D}/r10p.so", shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
L=[l for l in s.split('\n') if re.search(r'/\*[0-9a-f]{4,}\*/',l)]
print(len(L))
idx=[i for i,l in enumerate(L) if 'STL' in l or 'LDL' in l]
print('first/last idx', idx[:5], idx[-5:])
# classify neighbourhood by nearby markers
marks=['MUFU.EX2','UTCHMMA','UTMALDG','UBLKCP','REDG','ATOMG','RED.E','LDTM','F2FP','SYNCS','BAR.SYNC','LDG.E.128','STG.E.128']
for i in idx[::6]:
    win=' '.join(L[max(0,i-25):i+25])
    found=[m for m in marks if m in win]
    print(i, L[i].split(';')[0].strip()[-60:], '| near:', found)

import os, math, time, torch, subprocess
D='/tmp/r10p'
print('prev', os.path.exists(D+'/b.cu'))
b=open(D+'/b.cu').read()
def rep(s, old, new):
    assert s.count(old)==1, old[:60]; return s.replace(old,new)
# variant C: deferred W2 conversion hoisted out of the GEMM1 epilogue tile loop (same position for tile 0)
oldC1='''    int ti = 0;
    for (int t = cta; t < p.T1; t += P, ti++) {
      const bool last = (ti == ntc - 1);'''
newC1='''    if (ntc > 0 && warp >= 4) tc_w2_work<C_>(p, Ez * 16 + cta * 12 + (warp - 4), Wt, lane);
    int ti = 0;
    for (int t = cta; t < p.T1; t += P, ti++) {
      const bool last = (ti == ntc - 1);'''
oldC2='''      if (ti == 0 && warp >= 4) tc_w2_work<C_>(p, Ez * 16 + cta * 12 + (warp - 4), Wt, lane);
'''
bC=rep(rep(b,oldC1,newC1),oldC2,'')
# variant D (on top of C): per-warp chunk registers sized per instantiation (4 chunks at C=768, 5 at C=384)
bD=bC
bD=rep(bD,'      uint32_t hreg[5][8];','      constexpr int NCHW = (C_ >= 768) ? 4 : 5;\n      uint32_t hreg[NCHW][8];')
assert bD.count('      for (int c = 0; c < 5; c++) {')==2
bD=bD.replace('      for (int c = 0; c < 5; c++) {','      for (int c = 0; c < NCHW; c++) {')
open(D+'/bC.cu','w').write(bC); open(D+'/bD.cu','w').write(bD)
from torch.utils.cpp_extension import load
os.environ['TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST']='10.0a'
for nm,bb in (('C',bC),('D',bD)):
    os.makedirs(D+'/'+nm,exist_ok=True)
    src=open(D+'/a.cu').read()+bb+open(D+'/c.cu').read()+open(D+'/host.cu').read()
    open(D+f'/k{nm}.cu','w').write(src)
    t=time.time()
    load(name='r10'+nm, sources=[D+f'/k{nm}.cu', D+'/bind.cpp'], extra_cuda_cflags=['-O3','--use_fast_math','-std=c++17','-gencode=arch=compute_100a,code=sm_100a'], extra_ldflags=['-lcuda'], build_directory=D+'/'+nm, verbose=False)
    print(nm,'built',round(time.time()-t,1), subprocess.run(f'cuobjdump -res-usage {D}/{nm}/r10{nm}.so 2>&1 | grep -A1 -E "tc_kernelILi" | grep REG', shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip())

import os, math, time, torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
import b200probe
D='/tmp/r10p'
from torch.utils.cpp_extension import load
os.environ['TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST']='10.0a'
fl=['-O3','--use_fast_math','-std=c++17','-gencode=arch=compute_100a,code=sm_100a']
e0 = load(name='r10p', sources=[D+'/k.cu', D+'/bind.cpp'], extra_cuda_cflags=fl, extra_ldflags=['-lcuda'], build_directory=D, verbose=False)
eC = load(name='r10C', sources=[D+'/kC.cu', D+'/bind.cpp'], extra_cuda_cflags=fl, extra_ldflags=['-lcuda'], build_directory=D+'/C', verbose=False)
def gen(B,C,H,W):
    r=lambda *s: torch.randn(*s, device='cuda')
    return [r(B,C,H,W), r(C,1,7,7)/math.sqrt(7), r(C), torch.ones(C,device='cuda'), torch.zeros(C,device='cuda'),
            r(4*C,C)/math.sqrt(C), r(4*C), r(1,1,1,4*C)/math.sqrt(4*C), r(1,1,1,4*C), r(C,4*C)/math.sqrt(4*C), r(C)]
def ref64(ins):
    x,dww,dwb,lnw,lnb,w1,b1,gw,gb,w2,b2=[t.double() for t in ins]; C=x.shape[1]
    d=F.conv2d(x,dww,dwb,padding=3,groups=C).permute(0,2,3,1)
    a=F.layer_norm(d,(C,),lnw,lnb,1e-6); h=F.gelu(a@w1.t()+b1)
    G=torch.norm(h,p=2,dim=(1,2),keepdim=True); N=G/(G.mean(dim=-1,keepdim=True)+1e-6)
    h=gw*(h*N)+gb+h; y=h@w2.t()+b2
    return x+y.permute(0,3,1,2)
for (B,C,H,W) in [(2,768,7,7),(8,768,7,7),(16,768,7,7),(32,768,7,7),(8,384,14,14),(16,384,14,14)]:
    torch.manual_seed(200); ins=gen(B,C,H,W); out=torch.empty(B,C,H,W,device='cuda'); out2=torch.empty_like(out)
    e0.runm(*ins,out,0); eC.runm(*ins,out2,0); torch.cuda.synchronize()
    ref=ref64(ins); d=(out2.double()-ref).abs().max().item(); same=(out2-out).abs().max().item()
    res=[]
    for rep in range(3):
        a=b200probe.harness_time(lambda *z: e0.runm(*z,0), ins, [out]); c=b200probe.harness_time(lambda *z: eC.runm(*z,0), ins, [out])
        res.append((round(a,1),round(c,1)))
    extra=''
    if (B,C)==(16,384):
        t2=[round(b200probe.harness_time(lambda *z: eC.runm(*z,1), ins, [out]),1) for _ in range(3)]
        extra=f' tc2(C build): {t2}'
    print(f'{B},{C}: maxerr C {d:.3e}, |C-orig| {same:.2e}; (orig, C) x3: {res}{extra}')
